dedupe_keys.name: nasa community coordinated modeling center ccmc

description: The Community Coordinated Modeling Center (CCMC) at NASA Goddard is a multi-agency partnership that hosts, tests and runs space science and space weather models for the research and forecasting communities. It gives free access, worldwide, to research models of the Sun, heliosphere, magnetosphere, ionosphere and thermosphere through an automated runs-on-request system, provides online visualisation and analysis tools, runs several models continuously in real time, evaluates models against standard metrics as an unbiased agent, and supports the transition of research models to operations for forecasters. Its model catalogue lists the hosted models, and its tools include the DONKI space weather database. Access to model runs and results is free, some services need a user request form, and outputs follow each model's own formats. Caveats: runs on request queue on shared resources, the models are research codes with their own limits, and infrastructure impacts such as geomagnetically induced currents are only partly modelled. It serves scenario generation of geomagnetic storms and solar events for hazard exposure and resilience studies of power grids, satellites and GNSS, and complements the NOAA SWPC operational products and the DONKI database catalogued here.
